Pet travel overview for Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers who move with pets from booking through pickup. Use this guidance to prepare documents, confirm transport plans, and avoid delays at the skyport.

Before departure, submit the pet details requested by the desk and review the handling notes shared with your booking. The team records each service change in the desk ledger so the travel plan stays current. If a kennel, carrier, or walking break needs adjustment, report it early so staff can coordinate the change with the cabin and ground teams.

For Ashenfell, <<FACT F012>> Keep your pet calm, secure, and ready for inspection when requested. Pack familiar bedding, a lead, absorbent material, and any approved feeding items in a way that is easy to access. Do not place loose items with the animal, and make sure the carrier closes firmly before arrival.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F001>> If your route includes a lounge stop, follow the pet area rules and remain with your animal unless a staff member gives different directions. Watch for posted cleaning limits and return borrowed items promptly.

At the checkpoint, present the travel paperwork and follow the directions from the operations staff. Keep your pet close and avoid opening the carrier unless an officer asks you to do so. If your plans change, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as possible so the record can be updated.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways through the official support channel.
